label: neverUpscales: fitted's scale cap takes max for min, so a small image grows to fill the canvas
find: let scale = min(1, canvas.width / natural.width, canvas.height / natural.height)
replace: let scale = max(1, canvas.width / natural.width, canvas.height / natural.height)

label: coverKeepsAspect: the cover scale takes min for max, so the picture leaves gaps in its box
find: let scale = max(box.width / natural.width, box.height / natural.height)
replace: let scale = min(box.width / natural.width, box.height / natural.height)

label: focusEdgeCovers: drawnRect drops the clamp, so a focus past the edge uncovers the box
find: let x = clamp(fx, box.maxX - width, box.minX), y = clamp(fy, box.maxY - height, box.minY)

label: svgWithBOM: the UTF-8 BOM is not skipped, so an SVG saved with one is refused
